Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed classroom counts, building ages, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment with detailed project budgets and prioritization; integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Ch. 1-2, 16-26, 59-61).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections using multiple cohort survival methodologies; integrates residential development impact with student generation factors; capacity utilization data by site and grade with clear connection to facility actions (Ch. 3-15, 41, 67-68).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle; detailed descriptions of learning environments, specialized classrooms, and non-instructional spaces aligned with district mission and instructional goals; direct connection of facilities to educational programs across all school levels (Ch. 26-57).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with strategies for improvement such as shade structures, outdoor learning areas, and playground rehabilitation; references to site infrastructure and greening but lacks districtwide quantitative data on green surfaces or climate resilience framing (Ch. 16-26, 59-61, 117-119).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related facility needs such as HVAC upgrades and energy efficiency; includes some strategies like shade structures and stormwater management; however, lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or districtwide climate resilience integration (Ch. 16-26, 123-127).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Discusses energy efficiency strategies including HVAC upgrades, lighting replacements, and references to Title 24 and sustainability goals; mentions energy resilience goals but does not present comprehensive districtwide energy resilience or electrification plans (Ch. 16-26, 123-127, 153-157).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed capital improvement budgets totaling $436 million with project prioritization by site and type; outlines multiple funding sources including state grants, local bonds, developer fees, and alternative financing; includes financial fund balances and strategic recommendations (Ch. 58-61, 189-196).
